title: H0753 (2019 Regular): Licenses to Carry Concealed Weapons or Firearms

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Introduced, 2019-02-11; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2019/753/BillText/Filed/PDF (LegiScan doc 1903023))
provenance.note: Introduced version (filed 2019-02-11); later amendments are not in the text read. Struck: 7 years replaced by 4; the old list of equivalent-experience options is restructured.

operative_text:
Section 1 (s. 790.06, F.S.): Such licenses shall be valid throughout the state for a period of 4 years after the date of issuance.
Section 1 (s. 790.06, F.S.): The course of fire proficiency demonstration must be completed using live ammunition.
